en: Every notable jump or drop of the last 30 days, on any market, flagged on the candle it started on with the most likely cause: the first report of a story, a liquidation cascade from our own feed, volume, open interest, what leads this market, or an opening gap - and when we cannot find a cause the flag says so. Tap a flag for the evidence. While a move is forming it asks the same engine live.

A move is judged against this market’s own 30-day volatility. Only the first report of a story can claim a move, the follow-ups only add to its score. News must be dated inside 90 min before (or 30 min after) the move, a cascade is our own feed liquidating 6x the typical amount. Unknown is said out loud.
